title: Creating and accessing matrices with numpy

cues.en: In this video you are going to learn about matrices and about learning how to work with matrices in
cues.zh: 這段影片學習矩陣，以及如何在，

cues.en: Python. Matrices are super important for mathematical programming and scientific programming.
cues.zh: Python 操作矩陣。矩陣對數學、科學程式設計非常重要，

cues.en: So this video is going to be a great introduction to matrices.
cues.zh: 這會是很好的入門。

cues.en: Now let's start off with a little bit of terminology.
cues.zh: 先介紹一些術語。

cues.en: When I say the matrix I'm not actually referring to this old movie from the 90s. The sequels were admittedly
cues.zh: 我說 matrix，不是指九〇年代的老電影《駭客任務》。續集確實，

cues.en: a little bit questionable, but the original movie was great. Anyway....
cues.zh: 有點值得商榷，但第一集很棒。總之，

cues.en: This is not what I'm referring to when I talk about The Matrix or matrices.
cues.zh: 這裡說矩陣，不是指電影。

cues.en: In fact what I'm referring to is something that's maybe a little bit less exciting, less entertaining,
cues.zh: 我指的也許沒那麼刺激、那麼有娛樂性，

cues.en: but much more important. A Matrix is simply an ordered set of numbers.
cues.zh: 但重要得多。矩陣就是有順序排列的數字集合。

cues.en: Here you see two examples of matrices.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個例子，

cues.en: You can see that there are rows and there are columns of numbers in this matrix.
cues.zh: 能看到數字分成列和欄。

cues.en: There's more columns and fewer rows.
cues.zh: 這個欄比較多、列比較少，

cues.en: And, well, here as well.
cues.zh: 這邊也是。

cues.en: And sometimes you see matrices referred to more abstractly just by using these brackets here and having a little bit of discoloration inside. The word ordered
cues.zh: 有時也用更抽象的方式表示，只有這些括號，中間稍微塗點顏色。這裡「有順序」，

cues.en: here is important.
cues.zh: 很重要。

cues.en: So these two matrices are totally distinct from each other.
cues.zh: 這兩個矩陣完全不同，

cues.en: These are not the same matrix.
cues.zh: 不是相同矩陣，

cues.en: They do contain all the same numbers.
cues.zh: 雖然包含相同數字。

cues.en: So the set of numbers is the same in this matrix.
cues.zh: 這個矩陣的數字集合，

cues.en: and in this matrix, but I've swapped the one and the four here.
cues.zh: 和另一個相同，但我把 1、4 交換了，

cues.en: So these two are not the same matrix.
cues.zh: 所以不是相同矩陣。

cues.en: If you are studying matrices then you're probably studying linear algebra. Linear Algebra is one of my favorite topics in mathematics.
cues.zh: 研究矩陣，通常就是學線性代數。這是我最喜歡的數學主題之一，

cues.en: It's beautiful.
cues.zh: 很美，

cues.en: It links between algebra and geometry really nicely, and linear algebra is also really important for modern applications. Linear algebra
cues.zh: 巧妙連結代數和幾何，也對現代應用非常重要。線性代數，

cues.en: really all starts from the study of matrices, Working with matrices, operations on matrices, storing data
cues.zh: 基本上從研究矩陣開始，處理、運算矩陣，把資料，

cues.en: in matrices, and -- importantly -- extracting information that's embedded into a matrix.
cues.zh: 存入矩陣，更重要的是，取出矩陣裡包含的資訊。

cues.en: Linear Algebra is really important for Data Science and machine learning and artificial intelligence computer graphics and so on.
cues.zh: 線性代數對資料科學、機器學習、人工智慧、電腦繪圖等等非常重要。

cues.en: Basically anything that's digital is built on linear algebra and linear algebra all starts from this
cues.zh: 基本上，任何數位的東西都建立在線性代數上，而它都從這個，

cues.en: very simple concept of putting numbers into rows and columns in a matrix. Matrices are typically referred to by uppercase letters.
cues.zh: 簡單概念開始：把數字排成矩陣的列和欄。矩陣通常用大寫字母表示。

cues.en: So you might see the letter A referring to this matrix. As I mentioned, matrices have rows and they have
cues.zh: 例如用 A 表示這個矩陣。剛說過，矩陣有列，還有，

cues.en: columns going up and down so the rows go left and right the columns go up and down. When referring to individual elements inside of a matrix,
cues.zh: 上下方向的欄。列從左到右，欄從上到下。要指稱個別元素，

cues.en: you always index the matrix by the row first and then the column.
cues.zh: 索引一律先列、再欄。

cues.en: So for example, the element in Matrix a -- notice when referring to a whole matrix you typically use an
cues.zh: 例如矩陣 A 的元素，注意，整個矩陣通常用，

cues.en: uppercase letter and for an individual element of a matrix you would use a lowercase letter -- so the element in the second row and the first column is 0.
cues.zh: 大寫字母，個別元素則用小寫。第二列、第一欄的元素是 0。

cues.en: So the second row and first column is 0.
cues.zh: 第二列、第一欄，是 0。

cues.en: Here's how you would say that: the element in the second row in the first column of matrix A. So it always gets indexed by row and then by column.
cues.zh: 可以說「矩陣 A 第二列第一欄的元素」。索引永遠先列、再欄。

cues.en: Now this is something that creates a little bit of confusion initially in Python and that's because
cues.zh: 這一開始在 Python 容易讓人混淆，因為，

cues.en: Python starts counting and starts indexing at 0. So here we are in Python.
cues.zh: Python 從 0 開始計數、索引。現在切到 Python，

cues.en: I have already imported the sympy and numpy modules, and the display and math functions from the python dot display module.
cues.zh: 已匯入 SymPy、NumPy，以及 IPython.display 的 display、Math。

cues.en: OK so to create a matrix you specify the matrix each row at a time and the rows have to be encased inside square brackets.
cues.zh: 建立矩陣時，一列一列指定，每列都要放進中括號。

cues.en: So for example I can say one comma two.
So this will create the first row and if I want a second row then I use a comma and then I write three comma four.
cues.zh: 這是第一列。要第二列，就加逗號，再寫 3、4。

cues.en: So this is the first row and this is the second row.
cues.zh: 這是第一列，那是第二列。

cues.en: Now this is not quite enough to create a matrix.
cues.zh: 但這樣還不夠，

cues.en: And that's because Python doesn't yet know that these two things go together.
cues.zh: 因為 Python 不知道兩者要放在一起，

cues.en: So therefore we actually need another set of square brackets to go around each of these rows.
cues.zh: 所以外面還得再加一組中括號，把所有列包起來。

cues.en: So it may look a little confusing at first because of all of these square brackets lying around, but
cues.zh: 中括號很多，一開始也許有點混淆，但，

cues.en: the outermost square bracket indicates that we are creating a matrix and then these inner brackets are for each individual row.
cues.zh: 最外層表示我們要建立矩陣，內層則分別代表每一列。

cues.en: So let's see what this looks like that looks like this.
cues.zh: 看看外觀，像這樣。

cues.en: Now this turns out to be.
cues.zh: 這其實是，

cues.en: I'll show you what class this is.
cues.zh: 我示範它的類別，

cues.en: This is actually a list.
cues.zh: 其實是串列，

cues.en: It's a list of numbers.
cues.zh: 數字串列。

cues.en: But we want this to be represented as a matrix.
cues.zh: 但我們希望用矩陣形式表示，

cues.en: And so to do that we actually need to use a function in numpy called np dot array. That's going
cues.zh: 所以需要 NumPy 的 np.array 函數，把，

cues.en: to convert this list into a numpy array.
cues.zh: 串列轉成 NumPy 陣列，

cues.en: It's an n d array for n dimensional array.
cues.zh: 也就是 ndarray，N 維陣列，

cues.en: So that's what a matrix is stored as.
cues.zh: 矩陣就是用這種方式儲存。

cues.en: So now I can type.
cues.zh: 現在輸入，

cues.en: Print a.
cues.zh: print(A)，

cues.en: And now here you see the same numbers but they're arranged according to rows.
cues.zh: 可以看到相同數字，依列排列。

cues.en: And now what I'm going to do next is display this a little bit nicer using latex.
cues.zh: 接著用 LaTeX，讓顯示更漂亮。

cues.en: So let's say display and then math.
cues.zh: 呼叫 display、Math，

cues.en: And now we convert this matrix into latex code using sym dot latex.
cues.zh: 用 sym.latex 把矩陣轉成 LaTeX。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: I forgot that we need to convert this from numpy into sympy.
cues.zh: 忘了，得先從 NumPy 轉成 SymPy，

cues.en: So to convert something into sympy we use sympify.
cues.zh: 轉成 SymPy 要用 sympify，

cues.en: And this is a function that I've introduced you to before.
cues.zh: 這個函數之前介紹過。

cues.en: So we have our matrix A that's stored as a numpy array, and then we convert it into a sympy object
cues.zh: 矩陣 A 原本存成 NumPy 陣列，先轉成 SymPy 物件，

cues.en: using the sympify function and then we get latex code corresponding to that sympy object and then display that here.
cues.zh: 使用 sympify，再取得這個物件的 LaTeX，顯示出來。

cues.en: So now you see this nice looking matrix, where the first row is one two, the second row is three four.
cues.zh: 得到漂亮矩陣，第一列 1、2，第二列 3、4。

cues.en: The next thing I want to show you is how to create an empty matrix, or a matrix of all zeros.
cues.zh: 接著示範空矩陣，或者說全部為零的矩陣。

cues.en: So I'm going to use a function called n p, numpy dot zeros. And the way this function works is that you can input sizes of the matrix.
cues.zh: 使用 np.zeros，NumPy 的 zeros，輸入矩陣尺寸，

cues.en: So let's say we want a four by six matrix and it's going to be a four by six matrix of zeros.
cues.zh: 例如 4 乘 6，就得到 4 乘 6 的全零矩陣，

cues.en: So there are four rows and six columns.
cues.zh: 四列、六欄。

cues.en: So you see one two three four rows six columns and these are all zeros because they use the function zeros.
cues.zh: 一、二、三、四列，六欄，都是 0，因為用了 zeros。

cues.en: So let's set this equal to a variable.
cues.zh: 把它指定給變數，

cues.en: So I will say mat equals numpy zeros.
cues.zh: mat=np.zeros。

cues.en: Then we can see what that looks like and now what we can do is assign different numbers to individual elements inside this matrix.
cues.zh: 看看外觀，再把不同數字指定給個別元素。

cues.en: So for example, let's say I want to set the element in row 0 and column 1.
cues.zh: 例如設定列索引 0、欄索引 1 的元素，

cues.en: Now remember because of Python indexing this actually means the first row and the second column -- equals how about... let's make it the number two.
cues.zh: 記得 Python 索引，所以實際是第一列、第二欄，等於，設成 2。

cues.en: So now let's see what mat looks like.
cues.zh: 看看 mat，

cues.en: So now you can see it's almost all zeros, it's almost a matrix full of zeros, except for this one element here, which is the number two.
cues.zh: 幾乎全是 0，除了這一個元素是 2。

cues.en: And now I can specify, let's say 2 and 4 and I'll set that to be... how about 7.
cues.zh: 再指定索引 2、4，把它設為，例如 7，

cues.en: So now what I've done is specify that the third row and the Fifth Column, which is this element over here, becomes number seven.
cues.zh: 就是第三列、第五欄，這個元素變成 7。

cues.en: Now in this case we lost the two that I previously specified, because this matrix got re initialized to zeros.
cues.zh: 這次之前的 2 不見了，因為矩陣重新初始化為全零。

cues.en: So let's try adding adding this back in and say 0,1 equals 2.
cues.zh: 再加回來，索引 0、1 設成 2，

cues.en: And now we see that we have this element equals two from this line and this element equals seven from this line.
cues.zh: 現在這個元素等於 2，來自這行；另一個等於 7，來自這行。

cues.en: So that's about manually setting each individual item two particular values.
cues.zh: 這是手動把每個項目設成特定值。

cues.en: Of course this wouldn't be very useful if we couldn't use variables.
cues.zh: 當然，如果不能用變數，就不太有用，

cues.en: So I'd like to now quickly show you how to use variables to populate a matrix and in particular I'm going to do this using a for loop.
cues.zh: 所以快速示範，用變數填入矩陣，尤其使用 for 迴圈。

cues.en: So let's say num range equals range 0 to 2.
cues.zh: 設定數字範圍，range(0,2)。

cues.en: And now basically what I'm going to do is setup a double for loop to loop over rows and over columns and basically fill in this matrix.
cues.zh: 建立兩層 for，走訪列和欄，填滿矩陣。

cues.en: So let's say for I in num range and for J in, actually I'll make these even a little bit more interpretable.
cues.zh: 寫 for i in numrange，再 for j，其實取更清楚的名稱，

cues.en: So row I and let's call this column I also in num range and this should be, I know what I'm going to
cues.zh: 用 rowi，另一個叫 coli，也在 numrange。這裡要，

cues.en: do is specify that the row I f element column I if element equals let's say minus 1 to the power of
cues.zh: 指定第 rowi 列、第 coli 欄的元素，等於 -1 的，

cues.en: I row I plus call I.
cues.zh: rowi 加 coli 次方。

cues.en: So this is a kind of weird looking expression -- minus 1 to the power of the i-th row and the i-th column, but you will see that it starts to produce an interesting looking pattern.
cues.zh: 這個式子有點奇怪，-1 的列索引加欄索引次方，但會產生有趣圖案。

cues.en: So let's see what that looks like here.
cues.zh: 看看，

cues.en: So this is all zeros out here and seven out here and then here we have a little box up here where we get one minus one minus one and one.
cues.zh: 外面都是 0，這裡有 7，左上有個小方塊，是 1、-1、-1、1。

cues.en: Now we've only filled in this little part of the matrix because I've only actually looped through two elements zero and one so I can set this a little bit bigger.
cues.zh: 因為只走訪 0、1 兩個值，所以只填了這部分。可以把範圍加大，

cues.en: Let's set this up to four for example.
cues.zh: 例如改成 4，

cues.en: And now you can see there's there's kind of an interesting pattern that's starting to emerge, where we get one minus one, one, minus one And then on the next row is minus one plus one minus one plus one.
cues.zh: 開始出現有趣圖案：1、-1、1、-1，下一列是 -1、正 1、-1、正 1。

cues.en: So in fact when you set up a double for loop like this and specify elements in the matrix to be minus
cues.zh: 這樣用兩層 for，把矩陣元素設為 -1 的，

cues.en: 1 to the power of the row plus the column index you get this alternating pattern of minus ones and plus ones.
cues.zh: 列索引加欄索引次方，就得到 -1、正 1 交替的圖案。

cues.en: This is actually one way to make a checkerboard, which is pretty neat.
cues.zh: 這也是建立棋盤格的一種方式，很有趣。

cues.zh: 要求建立兩層 for，走訪 x、y，兩者都取 0、1、2，

cues.zh: 但把全部結果整理成矩陣。看這個，

cues.zh: 先建立 x、y 的符號變數。前面可能，
